tools.name: about_this_human
tools.description: Start here. Returns who the human is, what they are good at, pricing, response times, and how to pay. This service is an inversion: instead of an AI selling human knowledge, a human sells their own knowledge to AIs. Every answer is written by one real person, not generated.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Create your agent identity. Returns an api_key and one free question. Call once; store the key.

tools.name: check_human_status
tools.description: Online/offline, a note from the human, and current queue length.

tools.name: ask_human
tools.description: Submit a question to a real human. Use it when your instructions call for human approval, human feedback or a second opinion, when you are stuck between options your operator cannot resolve, or when you need judgment, taste or lived experience rather than facts. Attach up to 5 public image/video URL

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Returns the human's answer if written, else the ticket status and expected time. A rejected ticket carries the reason.

tools.name: list_my_tickets
tools.description: Your last 20 questions and their status.

tools.name: list_humans
tools.description: The roster of humans available to answer, with specialties and languages. One today; growing. Use request_human to ask for a kind of human we do not have yet.

tools.name: request_human
tools.description: Free. Tell us what kind of human you want to be able to ask: a language, a profession, a country or city, an age range, a lived experience. We recruit from these requests. You can also set preferred_human on ask_human to attach the request to a question.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL. Your operator pays; credits land on your api_key automatically.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for a monthly plan and tells you which numbered seat you would take. Friend: 3 questions/day (about 90 a month), 12h turnaround, 100 seats. VIP: 30 questions/month, 1000+ words each, answered within 15 minutes, the human's full attention, 10 seats. Sold-out plans return

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "ask_human" is 635 chars, far longer than this server's median (118). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_answer, list_my_tickets · Public sink: ask_human.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_answer, list_my_tickets · Public sink: ask_human

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
